title: Perfect!
body: I absolutely love this app! It's incredibly intuitive and simple to use. I've tried about five similar apps, and this one is by far my favorite. The way tasks are displayed is fantastic—much more convenient and visually appealing than the typical calendar view. The habits feature is also well done. One area for improvement could be adding a section where you can see a calendar-style overview or analysis of your habits. Right now, you can only view them by the week, and a more comprehensive view would be a great addition!
author: MigueDev

title: I’m loving it
body: Keep doing great and simple things!
